verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms v0 serves a machine-readable Markdown version of its docs at https://v0.app/docs.md (HTTP 200, with frontmatter). That is agent-consumable documentation an AI-native user could point an agent at. Only this single endpoint is evidenced, and no llms.txt index or first-party description of agent-oriented docs appears. missing for 10: an llms.txt / llms-full.txt index, first-party documentation describing agent-oriented docs, evidence that markdown is available across all doc pages, independent corroboration of agents consuming it

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
